channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The theme on Tuesday is power turning into compute. Google and Constellation signed a 20-year PPA that pays for uprates at 11 nuclear units, adding 890 MW of new capacity to PJM, plus a 15-year supply deal for 2,700 MW more (about 3,590 MW in total). Applied Digital reached Ready for Service on 75 MW more at Polaris Forge 1 in North Dakota, so 250 MW of the 400 MW campus is now live. In Japan, JERA, Dell and RHAELM signed an MoU for a 400 MW behind-the-meter AI campus at the Chiba Thermal Power Station, with more than US$15 billion of planned capital and Apollo as intended financing partner. The public rental tape is a full confirm session: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda, CoreWeave, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, GCP TPU and AWS Capacity Blocks. AWS's new Capacity Blocks card takes effect Wednesday 7 Oct (P5 $5.970, P6-B300 $16.146); today's live table still prints P5 Virginia $5.191 and P6-B300 Virginia $14.04. Applied Digital also announced access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland, with no counterparty or tenant named. Brookwood's council vote is still pending. PUCT 58481 takes effect 8 Oct; ERCOT RFI due 12 Oct; TCEQ update due 19 Oct; Fermi x TensorWave Matador due 31 Oct.

item.title: Compute brief - 6 October 2026
item.description: The theme on Tuesday is power turning into compute. Google and Constellation signed a 20-year PPA that pays for uprates at 11 nuclear units, adding 890 MW of new capacity to PJM, plus a 15-year supply deal for 2,700 MW more (about 3,590 MW in total). Applied Digital reached Ready for Service on 75 MW more at Polaris Forge 1 in North Dakota, so 250 MW of the 400 MW campus is now live. In Japan, JERA, Dell and RHAELM signed an MoU for a 400 MW behind-the-meter AI campus at the Chiba Thermal Power Station, with more than US$15 billion of planned capital and Apollo as intended financing partner. The public rental tape is a full confirm session: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda, CoreWeave, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, GCP TPU and AWS Capacity Blocks. AWS's new Capacity Blocks card takes effect Wednesday 7 Oct (P5 $5.970, P6-B300 $16.146); today's live table still prints P5 Virginia $5.191 and P6-B300 Virginia $14.04. Applied Digital also announced access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland, with no counterparty or tenant named. Brookwood's council vote is still pending. PUCT 58481 takes effect 8 Oct; ERCOT RFI due 12 Oct; TCEQ update due 19 Oct; Fermi x TensorWave Matador due 31 Oct. Countries: United States: Google 20-year PPA funds 890 MW of nuclear uprates at 11 Constellation units (IL/PA/NJ), first by 2028, plus a 15-year 2,700 MW supply deal in PJM (Wire, 6 Oct). United States / North Dakota: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1: 75 MW more Ready for Service; 250 MW of 400 MW contracted now operational (Wire, 2 Oct). Japan: JERA, Dell and RHAELM MoU: 400 MW behind-the-meter AI campus at Chiba Thermal Power Station, >US$15B planned, ops ~2028; MoU, no named offtaker (Wire, 1 Oct). Finland: Applied Digital agreement for access to up to 1 GW of potential power; initial power ~2028; marketing to hyperscalers; site and counterparty not disclosed (Signal). South Korea: Science ministry plans a 4.7 trillion won frontier-AI program from 2027 with 10,000 Vera Rubin GPUs, one lead developer by tender after the 2027 budget passes (Signal). United States / Alabama: Applied Digital Delta Forge 2: council TCEDA-backing vote still pending; baseline sound monitoring under way; no groundbreak; tenant unnamed.
